title: The determination cannot reach outside; self-experience is self-luminous

question.tension_point: Can the determination (adhyavasāya) establish an external object, or is self-experience self-luminous and self-contained?
question.why_it_matters: The reflexion-core cuts the Buddhist fallback to the determination as establishing externality; it is the load-bearing claim for the reflexivity/self-luminosity thesis.

pratijna.proposition: Can the determination (adhyavasāya) establish an external object, or is the self-experience self-luminous and self-contained?
pratijna.what_it_claims: The determination cannot establish anything outside; self-experience (vimarśa) is self-luminous, un-divided from memory-cognition.

evidence.claim: The awareness expressed as 'I' (ahaṃ-pratyavamarśa) is not treated as one more relation constructed between independently given elements.
Linguistic articulation does not show that the underlying self-awareness is itself produced by conceptual determination.
A light that merely showed the world without knowing that it showed it would be no different from crystal — it would reflect, but be inert.
What makes the light conscious (rather than a thing) is that it is aware of itself in the very act of manifesting.

examples.scenario: The child who cries 'the trees rush against the current' is told 'it is only seen so' — the outwardness is a manner of the seeing, not a thing established.
examples.what_it_shows: Externality is drawn by impression, not established by determination.

upanaya.application: The reflexion-core's determination-failure converges with ARG-002 (the I-grasp is not a construction) and ARG-004 (manifestation without vimarśa is inert).
cruxes: CRUX-REFLEXION-INERT: can an inert thing establish, or does establishment require the self-luminous non-inert?

nigamana.best_current_answer: The determination cannot establish externality; self-experience is self-luminous. This is locally supported, but the universal-Self (V2C) is not entailed.
nigamana.scope: Local self-luminosity: plausible. Universal-Self: underdetermined (open crux).

candidates.name: Self-luminous self-experience
candidates.position: The determination cannot establish externality; the self-experience is self-luminous, one, all.

candidates.name: The determination establishes externality
candidates.position: The determination (adhyavasāya) establishes an external object.
falsifiers: An inert thing cannot establish (the reflexion-core's argument)

state_of_play.summary: The reflexion-core argues the determination cannot reach outside; self-experience is self-luminous. All dependencies are UNRESOLVED (CANDIDATE).
state_of_play.what_survives: The determination-failure argument and the self-luminosity claim (gated accepted).
state_of_play.what_is_weakened: The universal-Self (V2C) is not entailed by per-act self-luminosity.
state_of_play.what_would_change_our_mind: Evidence that an inert thing can establish, or that the 'external' has independent standing in any part of cognition.
open_cruxes: Does the reflexion-core's 'one, self-luminous, all' commit to the universal-Self?
